issues.description: Ants racial bonus listed as +50% Production in Overview but racial_modifiers JSON shows 0.50 production_bonus (same thing, but Overview earlier says +25% Growth which contradicts)
issues.suggestion: Verify Ants bonus: Overview says '+50% Production' but earlier version mentioned '+25% Growth'. Ensure consistency.

issues.description: Future Tech effects are listed as 'General improvements' without specific implementation details
issues.suggestion: Consider specifying what 'general improvements' means for implementation (e.g., miniaturization bonus, research cost reduction, etc.)

summary: The Planetology technology tree specification is excellent and implementation-ready. It includes: comprehensive Overview with racial bonuses; complete 12-tier tech tree with 28 technologies plus 10 future tech levels; detailed statistics for all 8 technology categories (Terraforming, Colonization, Eco Restoration, Enrichment, Bio Weapons, Bio Defense, Cloning, Atmosphere); complete formulas for terraforming cost, pollution cleanup, bio weapon damage, and cloning; extensive JSON data schema with all technologies properly structured; thorough edge cases section; 4 worked examples; environment type reference table; and cross-references to related documents. The JSON is valid and parseable. Naming follows pet-themed conventions (Rabbits, Ants, Hermit Crabs). Minor issues: slight inconsistency in racial bonus description, and future tech lacks specific effects. Overall score 92/100 - PASSED.
